001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * The pump's running estimate of the insulin in the cartridge. Seen on the Tandem Mobi only.
009 *
010 * <p>Tandem's export and its Mobi app do not name this opcode, so the class name is provisional.
011 * The Mobi writes one of these every ~4 U delivered from the cartridge (consecutive records step
012 * by 3.8-4.2 U) and several more while tubing is being filled. It is not written each time the
013 * displayed amount changes.
014 *
015 * <p>Layout, confirmed on 553 records from 5 Mobi pumps (the maintainer's two and three other
016 * people's): float {@code insulinDelivered} at bytes 10-13, float {@code insulinRemaining} at
017 * 14-17, {@code displayedInsulinRemaining} at 18, zeros at 19-21, uint32 {@code driveCounter} at
018 * 22-25. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/148.
019 */
020@HistoryLogProps(
021    opCode = 231,
022    displayName = "Reservoir Estimate",
023    internalName = ""
024)
025public class ReservoirEstimateHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
026
027    /**
028     * {@link #getInsulinDelivered()} + {@link #getInsulinRemaining()} equalled this value (float bits
029     * 0x434beff2, about 203.94 U) to within 0.00002 U in every observed record (553/553).
030     */
031    public static final float OBSERVED_START_ESTIMATE = Float.intBitsToFloat(0x434beff2);
032
033    private float insulinDelivered;
034    private float insulinRemaining;
035    private int displayedInsulinRemaining;
036    private long driveCounter;
037
038    public ReservoirEstimateHistoryLog() {}
039    public ReservoirEstimateHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, float insulinDelivered, float insulinRemaining, int displayedInsulinRemaining, long driveCounter) {
040        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
041        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, insulinDelivered, insulinRemaining, displayedInsulinRemaining, driveCounter);
042        this.insulinDelivered = insulinDelivered;
043        this.insulinRemaining = insulinRemaining;
044        this.displayedInsulinRemaining = displayedInsulinRemaining;
045        this.driveCounter = driveCounter;
046    }
047
048    public int typeId() {
049        return 231;
050    }
051
052    /**
053     * <table border="1">
054     * <caption>Parsed fields for ReservoirEstimateHistoryLog:</caption>
055     * <tr><td><code>insulinDelivered</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
056     * <tr><td><code>insulinRemaining</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
057     * <tr><td><code>displayedInsulinRemaining</code></td><td><code>raw[18] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
058     * <tr><td><code>driveCounter</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
059     * </table>
060     */
061    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
062        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
063        this.cargo = raw;
064        parseBase(raw);
065        this.insulinDelivered = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 10);
066        this.insulinRemaining = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14);
067        this.displayedInsulinRemaining = raw[18] & 0xFF;
068        this.driveCounter = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22);
069    }
070
071    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, float insulinDelivered, float insulinRemaining, int displayedInsulinRemaining, long driveCounter) {
072        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
073            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(231, 0),
074            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
075            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
076            Bytes.toFloat(insulinDelivered),
077            Bytes.toFloat(insulinRemaining),
078            new byte[]{ (byte) displayedInsulinRemaining, 0, 0, 0 },
079            Bytes.toUint32(driveCounter)));
080    }
081
082    /**
083     * Units of insulin moved out of the cartridge since it was inserted, priming included.
084     *
085     * <p>It reads 0.00 in the record written with every {@link CartridgeInsertedHistoryLog} (4/4
086     * insertions in the maintainer's capture) and keeps counting through a tubing fill done without
087     * a cartridge change. It moves in lockstep with {@link #getDriveCounter()}: within one
088     * cartridge, {@code driveCounter == a + 1073.52 * insulinDelivered} to within 3 counts on every
089     * pump observed.
090     */
091    public float getInsulinDelivered() {
092        return insulinDelivered;
093    }
094
095    /**
096     * The pump's estimate of the units of insulin left in the cartridge.
097     *
098     * <p>This is not measured separately. It was {@link #OBSERVED_START_ESTIMATE} (about
099     * 203.94 U) minus {@link #getInsulinDelivered()} in 553/553 records across 5 Mobi pumps and
100     * many cartridges, so the pump appears to start every cartridge from the same 203.94 U figure
101     * (why, and whether that ever differs, is unknown). The record written at cartridge insertion
102     * reads 0.00 / 203.94, the same 203.94 U as the {@link FillEstimateFinalHistoryLog} written in
103     * that second. Treat it as an estimate, not a measurement.
104     */
105    public float getInsulinRemaining() {
106        return insulinRemaining;
107    }
108
109    /**
110     * The whole-unit amount the pump reports as remaining, or 0 while a fill is in progress.
111     *
112     * <p>In every non-zero record (300/300) this was {@link #getInsulinRemaining()} rounded to the
113     * nearest 5 U when it is at least 40 U, and rounded down to a whole unit below 40 U (e.g. 43.90
114     * reads 45, 39.91 reads 39). The {@code InsulinStatusResponse.currentInsulinAmount} polled
115     * nearest to the record (within 60 s) matched it in 100 of 113 non-fill records. In the other
116     * 13 the poll came 11-43 s later, read 1-5 U lower, and a bolus was logged within about a
117     * minute of the record.
118     */
119    public int getDisplayedInsulinRemaining() {
120        return displayedInsulinRemaining;
121    }
122
123    /**
124     * A drive position counter, about 1073.5 counts per unit (unit unknown beyond that).
125     *
126     * <p>It sits near 524,288 (2^19) when a cartridge is inserted and increases with delivery. The
127     * {@link PrimeInprocessHistoryLog} records written during a fill carry the same counter at
128     * bytes 14-17 (e.g. both read 524274 right after an insertion).
129     */
130    public long getDriveCounter() {
131        return driveCounter;
132    }
133}
